source_text: **(e) Rule out each legitimate look-alike.** For each look-alike listed in the entry, say in one line why it does not apply. A look-alike can downgrade a flag only if the passage supplies its features, or those features are common knowledge in the sense of step (b). A look-alike you would have to imagine (a mechanism that might exist, a default that might have been set) does not count. If one does apply, downgrade to "possible issue" or drop the flag, as the look-alike says.
